title: Students' attitudes on life satisfaction and career decisions

contacts.name: Stanimirović, Petar
contacts.affiliation: Univerzitet u Beogradu – Fakultet organizacionih nauka

descriptions: The database was developed during the 2024–25 school year with the goal of surveying students in Serbia about their approaches to dealing with uncertainty and risk, their life and career decision-making processes, as well as their levels of adaptability and resilience. In addition, the survey examined students’ life satisfaction, quality of life, and involvement in extracurricular activities.
